title: Task–Action CallingGraph Structural Delta Intelligence and Growth
description: TACG-SDIG develops a structural AI coding framework centered on Structural Delta Intelligence (SDI): the capability to identify, localize, retrieve, compare, compose, validate, and learn meaningful structural changes between known, observed, and desired system states. The framework organizes knowledge into four interacting structural planes—Task, Action, Mapping, and Delta—and extends the canonical Task/Action CallingGraph model into a 1A–1N knowledge architecture. TACG-SDIG introduces Graph Minus for meaningful structural difference isolation; Task–Action Delta Pairs (TADPs) linking intended change with implementation change; Two-Way Delta Search across Task and Action structural memories; candidate reconstruction, companion-delta and counter-evidence analysis; residual-delta search and primitive-level constrained forward walking; Delta Memory, Delta CCC/DNA, and Structural Evolution Trajectories; and Delta-Scoped Structural Governance for reachability, policy, security, and Task–Action consistency analysis. The resulting closed loop is: Fold → Localize → Graph Minus → Delta → Two-Way Search → Unfold/Reconstruct → Validate → Grow → Fold Back. The central engineering thesis is that AI coding intelligence can improve not only by generating better candidates, but also by making fewer candidates necessary through structural localization and reusable engineering-change memory.
notes: Version 1.0.0 establishes the initial TACG-SDIG research framework, including eight core research articles and eight canonical figures. Core concepts include the Four Structural Planes, the 1A–1N knowledge model, Graph Minus, Structural Delta Intelligence, Task–Action Delta Pairs, Two-Way Delta Search, candidate reconstruction, residual and companion deltas, counter-evidence, primitive-level constrained forward walking, Delta Memory, Delta CCC/DNA, Structural Evolution Trajectories, Delta-Scoped Structural Governance, and closed-loop Fold Back. Canonical principles include: 'Delta is a first-class structural knowledge object'; 'Search before generation'; 'Structures describe states; deltas describe change; trajectories describe evolution'; and 'Code tells AI what the system is; Delta tells AI how the system grows.'
